connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

objectType.description: The CRM object type whose pipeline will receive the new stage. Use `deals` for deal stages.

pipelineId.description: The ID of the pipeline that should receive the new stage.

label.description: The name of the stage as it is displayed in HubSpot. The label must be unique within the pipeline.

displayOrder.description: The order of the stage in the pipeline. If multiple stages share the same order, HubSpot sorts them alphabetically by label.

metadata.description: Additional stage metadata. For deal stages, HubSpot requires `probability` inside this object.

metadata.probability.description: For deal stages, the required close probability from `0.0` to `1.0`, where `0.0` is Closed Lost and `1.0` is Closed Won.

displayOrder.description: The order of the stage in the pipeline.

id.description: The unique ID of the created pipeline stage.

label.description: The stage name displayed in HubSpot.

metadata.description: Stage metadata such as deal probability.

updatedAt.description: When the stage was last updated.

writePermissions.description: HubSpot write-permission mode for the stage.

objectType.description: The HubSpot object type that will own the property, such as contacts, companies, deals, tickets, products, or a custom object type.

externalOptions.description: Whether the property options should be populated dynamically from HubSpot instead of a static option list.

referencedObjectType.description: The HubSpot object type that provides external option values. Use OWNER for HubSpot user-picker fields.

formField.description: Whether the property can be used on HubSpot forms.

displayOrder.description: Display order within the property group. HubSpot places -1 after positive values.

hidden.description: Whether the property should be hidden in HubSpot.

calculated.description: Whether the property is a calculated property.

createdAt.description: When the property definition was created.

createdUserId.description: The user ID that created the property.

dataSensitivity.description: The HubSpot data sensitivity classification for the property.

displayOrder.description: The HubSpot display order for the property.

externalOptions.description: Whether the property uses externally managed options.

fieldType.description: How the property is rendered in HubSpot.

formField.description: Whether the property can be used on forms.

groupName.description: The property group that owns the property.

hasUniqueValue.description: Whether HubSpot enforces unique values for the property.

hidden.description: Whether the property is hidden in HubSpot.

label.description: The HubSpot display label for the property.

modificationMetadata.description: HubSpot metadata describing whether the property can be archived or edited.

referencedObjectType.description: The HubSpot object type used for external option-backed properties.

updatedAt.description: When the property definition was last updated.

updatedUserId.description: The user ID that last updated the property.
